description: Integrate role-based dashboard routing into portal/page.tsx. After successful auth, branch on user.role to render the appropriate dashboard (ClientDashboard, CoordinatorDashboard, MatchmakerDashboard, or AdminDashboard). Guard API Docs link visibility to ADMIN only.
steps: Refactor src/app/portal/page.tsx: After successful login and token retrieval, add conditional branch based on user.role to render appropriate dashboard component

Add role branching logic: if role === 'client' render ClientDashboard; else if 'coordinator' render CoordinatorDashboard; else if 'matchmaker' render MatchmakerDashboard; else if 'admin' render AdminDashboard; else show error
Remove the old hardcoded immigration + matrimonial tab logic from portal/page.tsx (now extracted to ClientDashboard and AdminDashboard)
Update PortalHeader (or top bar render in each dashboard) to conditionally show API Docs link only when user.role === 'admin'
Update portal/page.tsx import statements to include all four dashboard components and PortalHeader
Verify that all dashboard components receive correct props (user, token, onLogout) and callbacks wire correctly
Test auth flow: login, register, Google sign-in should all work and route to correct dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Portal page renders without TypeScript errors after login
Client users see ClientDashboard with immigration and matrimonial tabs
Coordinator users see CoordinatorDashboard with QUICK INQUIRIES and FULL ASSESSMENTS tabs
Matchmaker users see MatchmakerDashboard with profiles and matches
Admin users see AdminDashboard with all data tabs
API Docs link is visible ONLY to ADMIN role
Logout works correctly from all dashboard types
npm run build passes with no errors
verification: npm run build — confirms full build succeeds and portal page compiles correctly
